node.title: Re^2: SerialPort issues under Windows 10
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The next issue I had was that [mod://Win32::SerialPort]'s ->read appears to be behaving non-blocking

It's actually just timing out immediately - adding the minimum of e.g. $port->read_const_time(1000); sets the read timeout to 1s.
